about: A node declares its methodologies as sources, each a git URL at a tag or a commit, all of a repository's skills or those named; a skills repository's skills need not carry its name, and the harnesses are the coding agents they are installed for.
yaml:
pos: 2
methodologies:
  - source: https://example.org/team/pr-gnome.git
    ref: v1.2.0
  - source: git@example.org:team/gtd
    ref: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567
    skills: [gtd-get-clear, gtd-weekly-review]
  - source: git@example.org:someone/shared-skills.git
    ref: v3
    skills: [share-skill]
    kind: skills-repository
harnesses: [codex, opencode, pi]
